senses.gloss: (cmp. פּוּעַ, פָּעָה) to blow, squirt into the mouth.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:13">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> (play on <cite ref="Q00298"><he>פועה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Exodus 1:15">Ex. I, 15</cite>) <he>שהיתה נוֹפַעַת יין וכ׳</he> she squirted wine into the child’s mouth after having given its mother to drink, v. <cite ref="N01025"><he>נָפַח</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to blow air into the lungs, to revive. Ib. שהיתה מַפִּיעָה את וכ׳ (or מְפִיעָה, fr. פּוּעַ) she revived the child when they said it was dead.
